audit.why: Framing is right: Vladimir is one of the weakest early laners, Naafiri owns the lane, Vladimir flips it with Riftmaker/Zhonya's teamfight scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Layers disagreed: full phases[3]/[4] said Skill and phases[6] said Vladimir while content win[] said Naafiri on all seven. Prose everywhere (spikes[3], late, whys[6]) says built Vladimir out-scales the pack.
audit.why: Aligned 4-5 and 6 to Naafiri (matching win[] and packet), and moved the 2+ items row to Vladimir on BOTH layers with matching whys — the page's own scaling prose grounds it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text contained a broken slot tag: 'Sanguine Pool (E-into-W... his W)'. Sanguine Pool is W, 28s at rank 1, untargetable 2s. 'early' had a typo 'poolching'.
audit.why: Kit is authority; Pool dodges your W lock-on and R — bait it first.
Pool is 28/25/22/19/16s; his Q 9s scaling to 4.6s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Missing interaction: Grievous Wounds timing vs Transfusion/Hemoplague sustain under-stated in lane text.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Eviscerate has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool (W): 28s at rank 1, 16s max, 2s untargetable — bait it before you spend W or R, then he has no answer for most of half a minute. - His Transfusion falls to a 4.6s cooldown maxed — never stand in poke range idle. - Your E is the out.

edits.before: Q the bleed, Q the consume, E through with the pack piling — a six-body trade he answered with one rotation.
edits.after: First Q bleeds, second consumes for bonus damage and sends the pack — his Transfusion cannot heal both daggers back.

edits.before: W-diving into held CC — the lock-on telegraphs, the dogs can't dodge, and the lane's one button answers everything.
edits.after: Shoved past the river with Pool up, he survives any dive and his jungler collects — commit only after the Pool is spent.

edits.before: Trade behind the screen and bleed the contacts — your early strings out-stat most of the lane's expectations.
edits.after: Trade behind the minions and buy Executioner's early — Transfusion healing decides every extended exchange here.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by Pooling your W dive, healing the trade back with Transfusion, and scaling to a Hemoplague you can't stop.

edits.before: You are the flank with a head count: R the approach, W through the front line, and let the hounds peel-proof the exit.
edits.after: Late he out-heals pack DPS — Hemoplague amps punish grouping, so flank the backline and hold R until his Pool is spent.

edits.before: Q-E strings on every contact — the pack heals you through trades and the bleed math compounds.
edits.after: Q-E strings on every contact — your burst outpaces his pre-item Transfusion healing here.

edits.before: R online: the vision sweep plus bigger pack makes every roam a scheduled accident for a side lane.
edits.after: R online: you still out-duel him — his 6 buys Hemoplague utility, yours buys a kill window.

edits.before: First item spike: the W dive plus full string deletes squishies. Hunt the half-bars.
edits.after: First item: Profane plus the full string bursts through his sustain before Riftmaker lands.

edits.before: Late Naafiri flanks: R the sweep, W the carry, and let the pack vote on the peel.
edits.after: Riftmaker and Zhonya's Vladimir out-heals the pack — pick him alone or lose the fight.

edits.before: At 2+ items you keep a slim edge only by ending before he scales.
edits.after: At 2+ items Riftmaker and Zhonya's Vladimir out-sustains your pack.

edits.before: Vladimir is miserable early with no sustain items yet and a long Sanguine Pool (E-into-W... his W) cooldown, so levels 3-5 you shove and all-in him repeatedly. Bait his Pool, then W-Q on top when it's down because it's his only escape and it costs him health. Your Packmate burst outpaces his early Q healing by a wide margin, so trade every time he steps up.
edits.after: Vladimir is miserable early with no sustain items yet and a 28-second rank-1 Sanguine Pool (W) cooldown, so levels 3-5 you shove and all-in him repeatedly. Bait his Pool, then W-Q on top when it's down because it's his only escape and it costs him health. Your Packmate burst outpaces his early Q healing by a wide margin, so trade every time he steps up.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours: Vladimir has one of the weakest early games in the mid pool, so trade with autos and Packmate pressure and force him to burn health poolching or healing.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours: Vladimir has one of the weakest early games in the mid pool, so trade with autos and Packmate pressure and force him to burn health on Tides of Blood or Pool.

notes: Chart: content said Naafiri on all seven rows while the full layer had Vladimir at first item and 2+ items. First item aligned to Naafiri (whys[5] and spikes[2] both say you burst him pre-Riftmaker; packet chart agrees). 2+ items aligned to Vladimir on both layers — the page's own spikes[3]/late prose says built Vladimir out-heals the pack; packet chart says Naafiri there but a 50.15% WR with heavy Vladimir scaling makes the prose the more defensible verdict, flag for QA if the packet chart should win instead. Fixed 'poolching' typo, broken '(E-into-W... his W)' tag, all three lintFindings, and folded the Grievous Wounds missing interaction into breakdown.early.
